response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT tr.ordertypedist, sf.instownpct
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND sf.instownpct IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
), type_averages AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_type_ownership
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  AVG(m.instownpct) AS avg_ownership,
  AVG(m.instownpct / ta.avg_type_ownership) AS avg_ratio_to_type_average,
  AVG(m.instownpct - o.avg_ownership) AS avg_excess_over_overall
FROM matched AS m
JOIN type_averages AS ta
  ON ta.ordertypedist = m.ordertypedist
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership;

assumptions.assumption: The overall ownership average and each order type mix average are calculated over the matched records with non-missing institutional ownership; each qualifying record contributes equally to the three requested averages.
